newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Chemiprokasei says plans merger.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Chemiprokasei says plans merger.

text.p: Japan's Chemiprokasei Kaisha Ltd, said on Thursday that it plans to absorb unlisted Toyo Wood Preservation Co Ltd on November 18.
In the planned merger, which Chemiprokasei said would help stabilise its business base, three Tokyo Wood shares will be exchanged for one Chemiprokasei share.
Chemiprokasei, a maker of ultraviolet ray absorbents, said in a statement that after the merger its capital would grow to 1.54 billion yen from a current 1.44 billion yen.
It also said its current profit would total 868 million yen for the year to March 1998, and increase to 1.09 billion yen the following year as a result of the move.
